verse: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verse_spoken: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing,
that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
prayer: Heavenly Father, you are the God of hope, and I come to you this morning.
Some things in my life feel heavy, and some prayers still feel unanswered.
But I choose to trust that you are still working, even when I cannot see it.
Fill me with your joy and your peace as I believe in you today.
Where discouragement has settled in my heart, breathe new life.
Lift my eyes from my problems and set them on your promises.
Let your Holy Spirit stir up a hope in me that does not fade.
Help me carry that hope to someone who feels forgotten today.
Bless my family, bless my home, and bless everyone praying with me.
